description: Tree crowns over the campus model EXTENT, traced on the NGII 2025 orthophoto (sheet 34702020) with CHMv2 heights and species types read on the SCNU 360 VR tour; every value is an estimate (추정). Written by scripts/campus-model/fetch/treeInventory.mjs.
frame: EPSG:5186 metres (east, north): trunk position after removing the photo's relief lean

positionMethods.photo-chm: photo crown centre moved back by the campus lean ratio x height (estimated)
positionMethods.vr-intersection: intersection of the crown bearings read from two refined VR stations (design §17 rule 2)

method.grid: 0.5 m cells, 2 x 2 sheet pixels each
method.canopy: smoothed excess green >= 0.22 (and 2g - r - b >= 5), g >= r, luma std over 2.5 m >= 3 (3 on CHMv2 canopy); crown shade (luma < 55) within 1.5 m on CHMv2 canopy; no crowns on GIS building footprints, MCEE sports grounds or water
method.tops: local maxima of CHMv2 (smoothed 1.2 m) + 1.5 x distance to the canopy edge (cap 4 m), window 2.5-5 m by height
method.crowns: geodesic flood inside the canopy from the tops, at most 12 m; crowns under 8 m2, brighter than luma 145 or more elongated than 2.8 dropped; diameter of the equal-area circle
method.height: CHMv2 maximum over the crown; 1.5 + 2.2 x radius (3-14 m, ASSUMED) where CHMv2 has no canopy
method.lean: position moved back by height x the campus lean ratio [-0.0485, 0.026000000000000002] m/m (median roof-edge fit of data/photo/building-lean.json)
method.trees: a photo crown is split into round(area / spacing disc) trees (spacing ginkgo 6.5 m, broadleaf 7.5 m, pine 6.5 m, metasequoia 5.5 m, conifer 3 m, shrub 4 m; at most 24) by k-means over its canopy cells; crown radius = 95th percentile distance (plus one cell) of the tree's cells, clamped to the species range (ginkgo 3-7 m, broadleaf 3-10 m, pine 3-9 m, metasequoia 3-6.5 m, conifer 1.5-3.5 m, shrub 2-6 m); height = CHMv2 maximum over its cells
method.species: VR group polygon (data/photo/tree-species.json) first; else the weighted majority VR colour class of the crowns within 9 m on the VR tour cube faces (tree_vr.py; yellow -> ginkgo on a street edge, broadleaf elsewhere, or metasequoia when columnar: height >= 12 m and height / diameter >= 1.8; warm -> broadleaf (zelkova/cherry); dark -> pine, or conifer when columnar; green -> broadleaf, or ginkgo on a street edge (within 6 m of a road zone) with a yellow neighbour); unseen crowns: MCEE forest type (321 conifer -> pine, 311 broadleaf), else photo tone (luma < 85 and (b - r) / sum < 0.05 -> pine), else broadleaf
